      THEN 1

      AND (
        p.area_geometrica_terreno IS NULL OR p.area_geometrica_terreno = 0

      THEN 0

  SELECT
    lpp.*
  FROM "lc_ph_predio" AS lpp
  LEFT JOIN p
    ON lpp.pk_id = p.pk_id
  WHERE
    p.pk_id IS NULL
), p3 AS (
  SELECT
    lgp.pk_id

  JOIN "lc_jur_novedadnumeropredial" AS ljn

    lgp.juridico_predio_cancelado = TRUE
    AND SUBSTRING(lgp.numero_predial_nacional, 22, 1) = '9'
), p4 AS (
  SELECT
    p2.*
  FROM p2

), p5 AS (
  SELECT
    fk_id,
    numero_predial_matriz,
